memory_update.text: US-listed pure-play ABF substrate manufacturers appear limited; the US-listed universe should be expanded through adjacent PCB, advanced-packaging, process-equipment, inspection/metrology, and specialty-chemicals nodes.

TTMI should remain on the underfollowed lane as an advanced-PCB/data-center computing candidate, but later layers must verify whether exposure is truly AI accelerator/interconnect-driven rather than broad PCB cyclicality.

ASYS is a small-cap speculative-shadow candidate for AI advanced-packaging and substrate-fabrication equipment; survival depends on evidence of repeat AI-related OSAT orders and durable revenue contribution.
MKSI may be a supplier-to-the-suppliers chokepoint candidate because ESI laser drilling and Atotech-related process technologies touch HDI, IC substrates, and ABF material processing.
AMKR is best treated as a downstream reference anchor for advanced-packaging capacity and customer validation, not as a direct ABF substrate play.

node: ABF substrates and advanced PCB/interconnect for AI accelerators, CPUs, GPUs, and advanced packages
summary: US-listed direct ABF substrate manufacturers are scarce because the core ABF supplier base is concentrated in Japan and Taiwan. The US-listed expansion path therefore maps mainly to adjacent advanced-PCB manufacturers, advanced-packaging OSATs, substrate/PCB process equipment, and narrow micro-cap equipment suppliers. For this underfollowed pass, TTMI and ASYS are the cleanest small/mid-cap discovery names; MKSI is a larger-cap but relevant process-equipment/materials supplier; AMKR is a reference anchor for advanced-packaging demand and customer validation rather than a direct ABF producer.
